Graduate Student Resources
This page contains resources and information for current Graduate Students in the Department of Chemistry. If you cannot find what you are looking for, please contact Amy Bearshall in the Department of Chemistry Graduate Office, room 4404 TBBC or by email.
Safety & Support Resources

Center for Student Wellness - https://wellness.utah.edu/
University Counseling Center - https://counselingcenter.utah.edu/
Huntsman Mental Health Institute Crisis Line - 801.587.3000
MySSP - https://myssp.app/ca/home (Virtual 24/7 support available in 32 languages)

Travel & Virtual Conference Assistance
If you are going to a conference to present your research findings, the Graduate School offers travel assistance for airfare, lodging and other expenses. Applications must be approved by the Graduate Education Committee Chair prior to being submitted to the Graduate School.

U of U Graduate School
Graduate students can find useful information regarding tuition benefits, health insurance, fellowships, travel awards, writing courses and thesis editing and submission on the Graduate School site.
